introduction:
Hi
This guide will show you how to fix a scratchy volume pot.

steps.title: Fixing the scratching noise
steps.description: To find what pot is making the noise by turning them to see what ones give a reaction

steps.title: Cleaning the pot
steps.description:
Pour or spray some isopropyl alcohol into the pot and turn it to help clean the inside
Make sure to use as close to 100% purity isopropyl alcohol as you can for the best results!
If this doesn't work after a couple attempts you will most likely need to replace the volume pot.
